title: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)

sections.label: Verdant smart mini-city estates
sections.summary: Describes a vision of green, smart, elderly-friendly estates in Punggol, Sengkang, Jurong Lake, Bidadari and Tengah.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: A verdant oasis, and nestled within it, flats, public and private, with smart features – elderly-friendly, family-focused, well interconnected, with clean air with minimal vehicular traffic.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: A city-state comprising other self-contained mini-cities, each a distinctive regional hub with their own commercial, business, social and educational facilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: This is not a pipe dream; this is work-in-progress.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: We already see signs of it in Punggol and Sengkang, also in the future developments for the Jurong Lake district, Bidadari and Tengah.

sections.label: Occupancy caps for rental flats
sections.summary: Notes the occupancy cap for larger flats was cut to six while 1-room and 2-room flats remain at four.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The writers of the article highlighted the fact that though the occupancy cap for the number of tenants allowed in larger flats have been brought down to six, the cap for 1-room and 2-room flats remains at four.

sections.label: Enhanced Proximity Housing Grant amounts
sections.summary: States the enhanced Proximity Housing Grant gives singles $15,000 with parents and $10,000 near parents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The newly enhanced Proximity Housing Grant also includes a higher grant of $15,000 for singles staying with their parents and $10,000 for those staying near their parents.

sections.label: Singles needing compassionate help
sections.summary: Says a separate group of singles deserves attention and a compassionate hand for their difficulties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: A separate group of singles also deserve our attention and a compassionate hand in addressing their difficulties.

sections.label: Better case management for children
sections.summary: Asks whether the Ministry can consider better case management of complex cases, if only for the children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Can the Ministry consider better case management of complex cases like these, if only for the children?

sections.label: Estate rejuvenation programmes and plans
sections.summary: Lists NRP, HIP and Remaking Our Heartlands, and asks what else the Ministry is looking at.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Today, we have the Neighbourhood Renewal Programme (NRP) and the Housing Improvement Programme (HIP) for our residential estates and the Remaking Our Heartlands Programme for neighbourhood centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: As more flats come of age, what else is the Ministry looking at to rejuvenate and refresh our estates?

sections.label: Apartments sold, not conserved
sections.summary: Apartments sold recently for $728 million will not be conserved.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Sold recently for $728 million, the apartments will, unfortunately, not be conserved.

sections.label: HDB rents subsidised flats
sections.summary: HDB rents out about 58,000 flats to low-income households at subsidised rates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: HDB currently rents out about 58,000 flats to low-income households at subsidised rates.

sections.label: Occupancy cap for small flats
sections.summary: The occupancy cap for 1- and 2-room flats in the open market is four persons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The occupancy cap for 1- and 2-room flats in the open market is four persons.

sections.label: HDB flat defects and popping tiles
sections.summary: HDB residents face defects like popping tiles, with 700 cases in early January, which HDB said was consistent with previous years and cooler temperatures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: HDB residents also face problems like cracking or popping tiles, leaky pipes and other defects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: There were 700 cases of popping tiles in the first half of January.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: HDB had said that such popping tiles were "consistent with the experience of previous years" and due to cooler temperatures.

sections.label: Malfunctioning lifts and repair waits
sections.summary: Malfunctioning lifts and long waits for repairs have become an increasing concern, from a Choa Chu Kang HDB block to Golden Mile Tower.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: From a Choa Chu Kang HDB block to Golden Mile Tower, malfunctioning lifts and the long waits for repairs have become an increasing concern.

sections.label: Building Information Modelling use
sections.summary: Building Information Modelling allows companies to build virtually before building for real.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: One area of significance is the use of Building Information Modelling (BIM) which allows companies to build virtually before building for real.

sections.label: High-tech built environment sector
sections.summary: The Minister is asked what is being done to push for a high-tech built environment sector providing good jobs and opportunities for local firms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Can the Minister update us on what is being done to push for a high-tech built environment sector which can provide good jobs for Singaporeans and improve opportunities for local firms?

sections.label: Families in financial difficulties
sections.summary: Families facing financial difficulties from loss of a sole breadwinner, divorce or bankruptcy, with some rental flat residents benefiting from the Fresh Start Housing Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Not to mention families thrust into financial difficulties due to loss of a sole breadwinner, divorce or even bankruptcy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I have seen some of my rental flat residents benefiting, for example, from the Fresh Start Housing Scheme.

sections.label: HDB build-ahead scheme
sections.summary: The speaker welcomes news that HDB has started a new scheme to build flats ahead prior to the launch.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Chairman, I welcome the news that HDB has started a new scheme to build flats ahead, prior to the launch.

sections.label: Singles buying resale and BTO flats
sections.summary: The question asks how many singles have bought resale and BTO flats in each of the last five years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Lastly, how many singles have bought resale and BTO flats in each of the last five years?

sections.label: Interim housing after matrimonial home
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether interim housing over a short period of months can be provided to those not benefiting from the sale of the matrimonial home.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: For this, I am asking if interim housing over a short period of months can be provided to those who do not benefit from the sale of their matrimonial home, or if one party has been forced to leave the matrimonial home on short notice.

sections.label: LPA and living will housing
sections.summary: Without a Lasting Power of Attorney or living will, they cannot downsize or go for regular housing options to better finance their remaining years.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Without a Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) or living will, they cannot downsize nor go for regular housing options to better finance their remaining years.

sections.label: Seniors and LPA sign-up
sections.summary: The speaker asks how seniors can be better prepared for rising dementia and suggests HDB encourage joint flat owners above 55 to sign up for LPA.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: So, how can seniors like them be better prepared for the situation, given the likely increase in dementia amongst our seniors?

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: I suggest that HDB assist and inform all seniors, the joint flat owners aged above 55, to be automatically encouraged to sign up for LPA.

sections.label: Property value means testing exemption
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether the Government will exempt the annual property value review in means testing for seniors in such properties for future aid schemes.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: For these seniors living in such properties, will the Government consider exempting the review of the annual property value in their means testing for future aid scheme?

sections.label: HDB rules and singles grants
sections.summary: The speaker asks HDB to review rules to assist these individuals, noting new housing grants for singles buying resale flats to live with or near parents.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Can HDB review the rules on how best to assist these individuals?

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: However, there are times when its own rules get in the way of this mission.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am glad of the new housing grants for singles to buy resale flats to live with or near their parents.

sections.label: Balance flat sale delay
sections.summary: A resident buying a balance flat said eight months passed from application without the sale being transacted, and was told to wait six more weeks for the grant process.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: One resident buying a balance flat told me that it took eight months from the time of application and yet the sale is still not transacted.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: After eight months, he is told to wait another six weeks for the grant process.

sections.label: HIP for post-1986 flats
sections.summary: The speaker says another rule needing review is not granting HIP to flats built after 1986.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Another rule which I feel needs review is not granting HIP to flats built after 1986.

sections.label: Leftover food and pests
sections.summary: The speaker says this will breed pigeons, rats and pests, and NEA does not consider it littering unless food is left more than two hours.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Otherwise this will result in breeding of pigeons, rats and pests.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I understood from the National Environment Agency (NEA) that the authorities do not consider it littering unless the food is left there for more than two hours.

sections.label: Senior support housing grant proposal
sections.summary: Proposes a senior support housing grant and reduced single's premium for those aged 55 and above buying short-lease 2-room flexi flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In line with the Prime Minister's recent message that we should look after the elderly, we should spare no effort in creating a society honouring our senior citizens, empowering every senior with the ability to own a roof over their heads and to live their lives in dignity should be the least we can do as a society to honour their contributions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: I propose establishing a senior support housing grant supporting any individual or family aged 55 and above wanting to get a short lease 2-room flexi flat for the first or second time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: This assessment can be based on their marital status, age and income level to determine the level of the said grant offered of, say, up to $10,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The fact that the single's premium remains at $15,000, even with a shorter lease being chosen, is another loophole that we can address for more affordable housing for our single seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: To reduce the heavy burden of the single's premium on our elderly poor singles, we should consider an additional scheme reducing the premium for any individual aged 55 and above purchasing a 2-room flexi flat for the first time on a shorter lease.

sections.label: HDB flat tenant cap reduced
sections.summary: HDB announced that from May this year the maximum tenants in 4-room and larger flats will be cut to six from nine.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: HDB recently announced that from May this year, the maximum number of tenants allowed in 4-room and larger HDB flats will be reduced to six, from the current nine.

sections.label: HIP toilet pipe replacement option
sections.summary: Asks HDB to let residents optionally replace toilet pipes and other common items under HIP, without government subsidy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: In the past, HIP would replace the main waste and soil discharge pipes in the toilets for all units as water seepage usually starts from the joint failure between floors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: However, the last two HIPs I came across in Hougang would not touch these pipes unless they leaked.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: A number of residents I spoke to would like to change the pipes in the toilets and for good reason as their flats are more than 35 years old and the pipes, though not leaking, are due for a change.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: I hope HDB can allow residents an option to replace those pipes as part of the essential improvement work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: The types of additional work some of these residents asked for are common home improvement works for things like changing the windows, changing the water piping for the entire flat or upgrading the earth leakage circuit breaker (ELCB), to name a few.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: I am not asking the Government to subsidise this work but to provide an option to residents under the framework of HIP to change these common items in their flats at the same time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: The cost of such improvement work can benefit from economies of scale sourcing if they are included in the HIP tender.

sections.label: Defu heavy vehicle car park plan
sections.summary: Asks whether the Defu Industrial Estate development plan includes a multi-storey heavy vehicle car park.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: In the development plan for Defu Industrial Estate, is there a plan to build a multi-storey heavy vehicle car park as some resident drivers I spoke to continue to face parking problems in the heavy vehicles parked along Tampines Road and Hougang Avenue 7?

sections.label: Temporary heavy vehicle parks request
sections.summary: Asks the Ministry to provide interim temporary heavy vehicle parks in Defu Industrial Estate and keep enforcement light.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Can the Ministry put up some temporary heavy vehicle parks in Defu Industrial Estate in the interim?

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: There are spots of vacant land there and these temporary heavy vehicle parks require minimal construction works and enforcement as all heavy vehicles have valid parking permits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: I hope the Ministry will continue to take a light touch approach in its enforcement of parking rules and regulations when these drivers have to resort to desperate measures to park their heavy vehicles so that they can go home early to get enough rest to drive the next day.

sections.label: Prefabricated flats awareness and defects
sections.summary: Asks about public awareness, HDB's target percentage of prefabricated BTOs, and extending the Defects Liability Period.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Will HDB and the Building and Construction Authority (BCA) provide increased public awareness on the renovation and maintenance of prefabricated homes?

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: I understand that HDB is aiming for 35% of new BTOs offered in 2019 to be using prefabricated construction.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: What ultimate percentage of new BTOs using prefabricated flats is HDB working towards?

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Lastly, as construction defects might take longer to show up in prefabricated construction, would HDB consider extending the Defects Liability Period beyond one year?

sections.label: Assist scheme for second-timer parents
sections.summary: Under the Assist scheme, 5% of the 30% of 2-room and 3-room BTO flats in non-mature estates set aside for second timers are reserved for this group of parents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Under this Assist scheme, 5% of the 30% of 2-room and 3-room BTO flats in non-mature estates set aside for second timers are reserved for this group of parents.

sections.label: Waiving consent for divorcees
sections.summary: Sole care and control are seldom awarded, and HDB granted over 200 waiver requests in three years, but the MP hopes the requirement is waived altogether for all divorcees.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I also note that sole care and control are now seldom awarded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I do understand that in the last three years, HDB granted more than 200 requests to waive the consent requirement but I hope that the Minister can consider waiving this requirement altogether for all divorcees.

sections.label: Farmland leases, insurance, fish farmers
sections.summary: The passage asks AVA to confirm 20-year farmland leases as a trend, ensure fair tendering for startups, educate farmers on insurance, and update on reducing plankton bloom and oil spill risks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Thirdly, recently, AVA has begun to offer 20-year leases rather than the 10-year leases previously for farmland, which is a welcome move.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Can AVA confirm if this will be the trend for future farmland tenders?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Also, what measures are being taken to ensure that the tendering process is fair to entrepreneurial startups vis-à-vis large international agri-business firms, since we may want to nurture innovative startups in this sector with the potential to become globally competitive?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Fourthly, around the world, a major trend is the increasing take-up of insurance and micro-insurance in the farming sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: However, our fish farmers have faced issues collecting insurance claims from natural disasters in the past.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: What has AVA done to help to educate farmers about insurance and the options they have?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: And, lastly, Sir, and specifically in relation to fish farmers, can MND provide an update on the efforts to reduce the risk of disasters like plankton bloom and oil spills which can potentially devastate the livelihoods of fish farmers, among other harmful effects?

sections.label: Breakaway works affecting neighbours
sections.summary: Breakaway works in landed property redevelopment have caused difficulties for neighbours, including water seepage from exposed party walls and concerns about structural integrity.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Sometimes, the works on landed property will involve breakaway works, when, for example, a semi-detached house is redeveloped to become a bungalow, or an intermediate terrace house is redeveloped as a corner terrace.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I have observed a few cases in my ward where such breakaway works have caused significant difficulties and anguish to neighbours, that is, the houses that are exposed after the detachment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: One problem would be water seepage, as a party wall that formerly separated two adjoining houses would now become an exposed blank wall.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Another concern that has arisen is whether works done by one party have affected the structural integrity of the neighbour's remaining party wall.

sections.label: BCA approach to seepage problems
sections.summary: The passage asks how BCA will approach seepage in a neighbour's home and how far it relies on Qualified Persons versus actively investigating.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: When problems arise, for example, seepage occurs in the neighbour's home, how will BCA approach the issue?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: How far does BCA rely on the Qualified Persons engaged by the project owners to ensure compliance with the relevant regulations, or will it actively investigate?

sections.label: Rail Corridor development interest
sections.summary: The 24-kilometre Rail Corridor from Tanjong Pagar to Woodlands has drawn wide interest from Singaporeans of all walks of life.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Chairman, the 24-kilometre Rail Corridor from Tanjong Pagar to Woodlands is a development that has drawn wide interest from Singaporeans of all walks of life.

sections.label: MND URA public feedback plans
sections.summary: The passage asks for an update of MND/URA's plans arising from the public feedback.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: May we have an update of MND/URA’s plans arising from the public feedback?

sections.label: Rail Corridor land sales review
sections.summary: The passage asks whether MND is reviewing Government land sales in the Rail Corridor area.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Likewise, our Rail Corridor has considerable room for expansion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: So, I would like to ask if MND is reviewing Government land sales in this area to capture or enhance the vitality of this development.

sections.label: MND plans with LTA
sections.summary: The passage asks what MND's plans are with the Land Transport Authority.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: What are MND’s plans with the Land Transport Authority (LTA)?

sections.label: Built Environment ITM and MCST
sections.summary: The passage asks for clarity on how the Built Environment cluster of the ITM focuses on MCST developments.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I would like to ask for greater clarity about how the Built Environment cluster of the ITM focuses on management corporations of strata title (MCST) developments.

sections.label: Google Playstore Singapore downloads
sections.summary: The passage states that according to the Google Playstore there have been around 50,000 downloads in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: According to the Google Playstore, there have only been around 50,000 downloads in Singapore.

sections.label: Cleaners and corridor washing frequency
sections.summary: The passage states Singapore has 56,000 cleaners and that Tampines Town Council reduced corridor washing frequency from monthly to once every two months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Singapore already has more cleaners than a typical cohort of National Servicemen – 56,000 of them, really an army of cleaners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Last year, the Tampines Town Council reduced the corridor washing frequency from monthly to once every two months.

sections.label: Outsourcing litter removal to Town Councils
sections.summary: The speaker suggests DPC's daily litter removal could be outsourced to Town Councils, with operational details sorted among agencies, and asks MSO to explore better coordination of municipal services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: The daily removal of litter, which is done by DPC, could be outsourced to the Town Council, which already takes care of most parts of the HDB estate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Obviously, there will be operational details like contracting, budget and public liability that need to be looked into, but I believe these could be sorted out among the different agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: I hope MSO could explore how the actual execution and delivery of municipal services can be better coordinated at the whole-of-Government level, including Town Councils, so as to deliver services efficiently for our residents.

sections.label: Building infrastructure for future Singapore
sections.summary: Minister Heng Swee Keat's Budget vision of Singapore as a Global-Asia node of technology, innovation and enterprise requires building infrastructure, hence a major pipeline of projects over the coming decade.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In his Budget Statement, Minister Heng Swee Keat shared the vision for Singapore to be a Global-Asia node of technology, innovation and enterprise, and there was broad support in this House for this vision.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, we have to work hard now to make this vision a reality.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: There are many aspects to this work, but a major part of it is to build the infrastructure for our future Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: That is why we have a major pipeline of projects over the coming decade.

sections.label: HDB flat supply ramp-up and tapering
sections.summary: HDB ramped up flat supply in 2011, launching almost 25,000 BTO flats per year and clearing the backlog, and has since been tapering new flat supply.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Members will recall how we had ramped up HDB flat supply in 2011.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We launched almost 25,000 BTO flats per year and cleared the backlog at that time and, since then, we have been tapering the supply of new HDB flats.

sections.label: First batch of 1,100 flats
sections.summary: HDB will launch the first batch of 1,100 flats in Sembawang, Sengkang and Yishun this year, with a waiting time of around two to three years instead of three to four.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: HDB will launch the first batch of 1,100 such flats in Sembawang, Sengkang and Yishun this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The waiting time for these flats is around two to three years, as opposed to the normal waiting time of about three to four years.

sections.label: Grants for first-timer resale flat buyers
sections.summary: First-timer families can now receive up to $120,000 in grants when buying a resale flat, a 50% increase compared to three years ago.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Taken together with all the different grants, when you take all the different grants together, first-timer families can now receive up to $120,000 in grants when buying a resale flat, and that is a 50% increase, compared to three years ago.

sections.label: Deferring income assessment for young couples
sections.summary: Young couples who have considered it carefully can apply for a flat first and defer income assessment for housing loans and grants until just before key collection.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But for young couples who have considered it carefully, I think we can exercise some flexibility to support them in their marriage and parenthood journey.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, we will now allow such couples to apply for the flat first and defer the assessment of income for housing loans and grants till just before key collection.

sections.label: Deferred income assessment for couples
sections.summary: Eligible couples from the May 2018 BTO/SBF exercise get deferred income assessment, with income checked just before key collection for loan quantum and housing grants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, during that period, the couple can have time to build up their finances and, just before key collection, we will assess their income for purposes of determining the loan quantum and housing grants that they are eligible for.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: This deferred assessment of income will apply to eligible couples from the May 2018 BTO/Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) exercise.

sections.label: Single platform eligibility checks
sections.summary: Eligibility checks are done on one platform, cutting appointments from two to one and application time from 16 to eight weeks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: All the eligibility checks are now done on one single platform.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We cut down the appointment from two to one and, as a result, the application time is reduced from 16 weeks to eight weeks.

sections.label: ROF single queue shortens selection
sections.summary: With ROF, balance flats are pooled into one single queue, shortening the flat selection process from eight months to six months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But with ROF, we have one single queue because all of the balance flats are pooled together.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, because of that, we were able to shorten the flat selection process from eight months to six months.

sections.label: Halving balloting time to three weeks
sections.summary: The HDB team has been challenged to see if balloting time can be halved to three weeks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Still, I think, the time taken can be reduced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, I have challenged the HDB team to see if they can halve the balloting time to three weeks.

sections.label: Simplified proximity condition to four km
sections.summary: Besides enhancing the grant quantum this year, the proximity condition was simplified to a distance-based one within four kilometres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Besides enhancing the grant quantum this year, we have also simplified the proximity condition to a distance-based one, within four kilometres (km).

sections.label: Capped levy for second-timers
sections.summary: For second-timers, the levy is capped and adjusted for shorter leases, with a maximum of $18,000 on a 2-room flexi 45-year lease.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For second-timers, there is a levy to be paid, but we have capped the levy amount and adjusted it for the shorter lease.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, the maximum levy that would be paid on a 2-room flexi on a 45-year lease is $18,000, much lower than what a normal resale levy would be.

sections.label: Housing grants for singles
sections.summary: Singles buying resale flats with or near parents get higher grants, and may receive up to $60,000 in grants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Because with the changes to PHG, as Members here have recognised, we are giving a higher grant of $15,000 for singles who buy a resale flat to live with their parents and now they are eligible also for a $10,000 grant to buy a resale flat near their parents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Again, taken together with all the other housing grants, singles may now receive up to $60,000 in grants to buy a resale flat.

sections.label: Removal of divorce time bar
sections.summary: The time bar on divorced couples with children buying subsidised flats is removed completely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Since 2012, we have waived the mutual consent requirement for the parent with sole care and control of young children to buy a subsidised flat, in order to prioritise their housing needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: This has helped the majority of divorced couples with children, but there are others still subject to the time bar.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have reviewed the matter and we have decided to remove the time bar completely.

sections.label: Universal Design in buildings
sections.summary: Buildings and public facilities will be designed for people of all ages and abilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: First, we must improve the way we design our buildings and public facilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We are going for Universal Design, that means, designing for people of all ages and all abilities, both young and old, expectant mothers, as well as persons with special needs.

sections.label: Lift upgrading and EASE programme
sections.summary: HDB upgrades lifts, adds elderly-friendly designs, and subsidises fittings for seniors through EASE.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have been upgrading lifts in HDB blocks to provide direct lift access to households and incorporating elderly-friendly designs in our flats and estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We also have the Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE) programme to provide subsidised installation of fittings for our seniors, be it grab bars or anti-slip treatment to their bathroom tiles.

sections.label: Assistance for multi-step entrances
sections.summary: Assistance for those living in flats with multi-step entrances is being looked at, with an update later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: One particular item that we are looking at is to include assistance for those living in flats with multi-step entrances, and we will provide an update on this later this year.

sections.label: Assisted living in public housing
sections.summary: HDB and MOH will pilot assisted living in public housing, with HDB building flats and private expertise providing services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: HDB will be working with the Ministry of Health (MOH) to pilot assisted living in public housing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We envisage a collaborative model where HDB will design and build the flat, and we will have to tap on private expertise to provide the services.

sections.label: Remaking Our Heartland and NRP
sections.summary: The Remaking our Heartland initiative covers nine HDB towns, and 20 Neighbourhood Renewal Programme projects will be launched this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: At the town level, our Remaking our Heartland (ROH) initiative has covered nine HDB towns and estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: At the precinct level, we have the Neighbourhood Renewal Programme (NRP) for our older estates built up to 1995.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We typically select about 14 NRP projects a year, and I am happy to announce that, this year, we will increase the number and launch 20 NRP projects across the island.

sections.label: Selection of eligible flats
sections.summary: For flats built up to 1986, selection of existing eligible flats finishes by end of this year, with works completed around 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: This is for flats built up to 1986.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will finish selection of the existing eligible flats by the end of this year and expect works to be progressively completed around 2022.

sections.label: BTO projects with mixed flats
sections.summary: Three BTO projects with rental and sold flats in the same block were launched in Woodlands, Bukit Batok and Sengkang.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: More recently, we have also launched three BTO projects with rental and sold flats within the same block itself.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: This is in Woodlands, Bukit Batok and Sengkang.

sections.label: Keeping central cluster buildings
sections.summary: After considering feedback, the central cluster of six buildings around the courtyard, including the dove playground, will be kept and repurposed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Mr Lim Biow Chuan spoke about this in Parliament.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have considered the feedback and, in December last year, we announced that the central cluster of six buildings around the courtyard will be kept and repurposed, and that includes the dove playground which I think many have fond memories of.

sections.label: Rail Corridor central stretch works
sections.summary: The central four-km stretch of the Rail Corridor is being worked on, transforming the Bukit Timah Railway Station into a community node.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For a start, we are working on the central four-km stretch of the Rail Corridor based on public feedback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will transform the conserved Bukit Timah Railway Station into a vibrant community node with amenities, open spaces as well as a heritage gallery.

sections.label: Walking running cycling by 2021
sections.summary: The entire 24-km stretch can be walked, run and cycled along by 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: You can walk, run and cycle along the entire 24-km stretch by 2021.

sections.label: Nature parks and Round Island Route
sections.summary: It will have convenient access to nature parks around the Bukit Timah and Central Catchment Nature Reserves and connect to the 150-km Round Island Route.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: It will have convenient access to nature parks around the Bukit Timah and Central Catchment Nature Reserves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: It will connect to the Round Island Route, which is a 150-km continuous green trail which loops around the entire island.

sections.label: Build-a-Playground pilot in Sembawang
sections.summary: A pilot called Build-a-Playground was recently launched in Sembawang.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Recently, we launched a pilot in Sembawang called Build-a-Playground.

sections.label: Daily municipal feedback volume
sections.summary: Government agencies and Town Councils receive about 3,000 feedback on municipal issues from residents every day.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Every day, Government agencies and Town Councils receive some 3,000 feedback on municipal issues from residents.

sections.label: Municipal service delivery progress
sections.summary: It now takes 11 working days to resolve 90% of complex feedback involving multiple parties, improved from 16 working days in end 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To Mr Ong Teng Koon's query, I am pleased to report that good progress had been made by the Government agencies, Town Councils and MSO in improving municipal service delivery.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: It now takes 11 working days to resolve 90% of complex feedback involving multiple parties, a marked improvement from the 16 working days in end 2015.

sections.label: Registered users and cases growth
sections.summary: In 2017, registered users and cases submitted grew by 43% and 100%, reaching 114,000 users and 153,000 cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In 2017 alone, the number of registered users and cases submitted grew by 43% and 100% respectively, reaching 114,000 registered users and 153,000 cases submitted.

sections.label: Expansion to eleven categories
sections.summary: It has expanded to eleven categories covering municipal issues under Government agencies, Town Councils and private entities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Today, this has expanded to eleven categories, covering not just municipal issues under the purview of Government agencies, but also those of Town Councils and even private entities.

sections.label: MSO Smart Nation sensor data
sections.summary: MSO will incorporate data from Smart Nation infrastructure elements such as sensors to enhance analysis of problem areas and anticipate residents' needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Going forward, MSO will also incorporate data collected from relevant elements of our Smart Nation infrastructure, such as sensors, to further enhance our analysis of problem areas and move upstream to better anticipate the needs of our residents.

sections.label: MSO NEA cleaning design guidelines
sections.summary: MSO and NEA are working with infrastructure agencies, consulting Town Councils, to set design specifications and guidelines for cleaning operations, including automated cleaning.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: For a start, MSO and NEA are working with infrastructure agencies, in consultation with the Town Councils, to establish design specifications and guidelines that will facilitate cleaning operations, including automated cleaning operations.

sections.label: Local Infrastructure Projects scheme launch
sections.summary: After a pilot that received some 140 infrastructure requests, MSO will launch the Local Infrastructure Projects scheme in 2018 with an initial $3.6 million budget for two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: MSO has thus piloted a small funding scheme to plug this gap.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Some 140 infrastructure requests were received for the pilot.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: With the success of the pilot, MSO will be launching the Local Infrastructure Projects (LIP) scheme for small-scale local infrastructure on state land in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: For a start, the LIP scheme will have an initial budget of $3.6 million for the next two years.

sections.label: DfMA adoption rate target
sections.summary: By 2020, the target is to increase the DfMA adoption rate to 40% of new developments, up from about 20% today.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: By 2020, we target to increase the DfMA adoption rate to 40% of new developments, up from about 20% today.

sections.label: BIM submission and adoption
sections.summary: Since 2015, building plans for developments larger than 5,000 sq metres must be submitted using BIM; 86% of large consultants and 65% of large contractors now use BIM.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Since 2015, building plans for developments larger than 5,000 sq metres have to be submitted to BCA and other regulatory agencies using BIM.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Eighty-six percent of our large consultants and 65% of our large contractors now make good use of BIM.

sections.label: IDD project adoption target
sections.summary: By 2020, the target is to have between 40 and 60 projects adopting IDD, compared to five projects today.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: By 2020, we target to have between 40 and 60 projects adopting IDD, compared to five projects today.

sections.label: CPCF funds and firms
sections.summary: About $530 million has been committed under CPCF, benefiting over 9,000 firms, 90% of them SMEs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: About $530 million in funds have already been committed under CPCF, benefiting over 9,000 firms, 90% of which are our SMEs.

sections.label: Singaporean consortium secures startup area
sections.summary: A Singaporean consortium of Ascendas-Singbridge and Sembcorp has secured a startup area to kickstart the new city's development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: A Singaporean consortium comprising Ascendas-Singbridge and Sembcorp has secured a startup area to kickstart the new city’s development.

sections.label: Tripartite FM Implementation Committee
sections.summary: BCA will bring industry, unions and Government together in a Tripartite FM Implementation Committee to formulate, oversee and review implementation plans for the sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To operationalise this, BCA will be bringing industry, unions and the Government together in a Tripartite FM Implementation Committee (FMIC) to formulate, oversee and review the implementation of the plans for this sector.

sections.label: Build-Singapore transformation office
sections.summary: BCA will set up a built environment transformation office called Build-Singapore (Build.SG) to galvanise industry transformation to build the future city.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To drive our built environment implementation efforts, BCA will set up a transformation office for the whole built environment sector, as previously announced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will call this office Build-Singapore (Build.SG) to reflect its purpose of galvanising industry transformation to build our future city.

sections.label: Cities of Tomorrow R&D funding
sections.summary: MND and partner agencies will launch calls for research ideas under the Cities of Tomorrow R&D Programme, committing up to $40 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As part of this effort, MND and our partner agencies will be launching a series of calls for research ideas under the Cities of Tomorrow Research and Development (R&D) Programme over the next few months, committing up to $40 million of research funds.

sections.label: Facade inspection requirements
sections.summary: Facade inspection requirements will cover buildings taller than 13 metres and older than 20 years, inspected by trained personnel every seven years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As Mr Chong Kee Hiong pointed out, it is also important to ensure that non-structural aspects like building facades are well-maintained, especially as the city grows older.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We have studied this and will be introducing façade inspection requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The regime will focus on buildings taller than 13 metres and older than 20 years, as they may pose higher risks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Inspection must be carried out by trained personnel and be conducted once every seven years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Now, this takes into consideration the expected lifespan of some common façade materials, allows for detection of façade deterioration to facilitate timely repairs and aligns this with the typical length of Repair and Redecoration (R&R) cycles for HDB estates and the majority of condominium developments, to save costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We aim to finalise the relevant legislation by end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Building owners will be given about one year’s lead time to prepare, before the requirement comes into effect.

sections.label: Building Control Act enforcement
sections.summary: BCA will investigate structural complaints and take enforcement action for Building Control Act breaches, and legislative changes will be studied.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: If there are complaints about structural issues, BCA will investigate and take appropriate enforcement action for any breach of the Building Control Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Having said that, similar to my response to Er Dr Lee Bee Wah, we will study whether legislative changes are needed.

sections.label: HDB renovation flexibility study
sections.summary: HDB is studying ways to give flat owners more flexibility for renovation even in such units.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: HDB is studying ways to give flat owners more flexibility for renovation even in such units.

sections.label: AVA stray dog programme
sections.summary: AVA will partner institutions, welfare groups and the public, and launch a Trap-Neuter-Release-Manage Programme for stray dogs this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: AVA will continue to partner IHLs, Animal Welfare Groups (AWG) and the broader public to address human-animal issues and develop solutions, using a humane science-based approach that involves close partnerships with the community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This year, AVA will launch a Trap-Neuter-Release-Manage Programme for stray dogs and we look forward to working closely with AWGs and veterinarians to make this programme a success.

sections.label: Enforcement at feeding hotspots
sections.summary: For hotspots with persistent irresponsible feeding cases, agencies will be asked to step up enforcement, and Members' feedback is welcomed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: That said, we recognise that there are a small number of irresponsible feeders despite this increased engagement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, for hotspots with persistent cases, we will ask our agencies to step up enforcement and we welcome Members' feedback on specific areas that need to be focused on.

sections.label: Farm Transformation Map launch
sections.summary: AVA launched the Farm Transformation Map last year with the Industry Consultation Panel to nurture the agricultural sector's growth.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Both Members spoke about its importance and how we should continue to nurture the growth of our agricultural sector.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: That is why AVA launched the Farm Transformation Map (FTM) in collaboration with the Industry Consultation Panel last year.

sections.label: New farmland tenders
sections.summary: AVA launched new farmland tenders on 20-year leases last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: For instance, AVA launched the new farmland tenders on 20-year leases last year.

sections.label: APF co-funding for farms
sections.summary: APF co-funding cap rises from $700,000 to $2 million for strategic food farms, and a new test-bedding component co-funds up to $500,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We appreciate that this poses challenges for many of our farms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: So, to help farmers take this leap, we are increasing the APF Productivity Enhancement component's co-funding cap from $700,000 to $2 million for our strategic food farms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Several rounds of trials are usually necessary before farmers can commit to a particular technology or a system at a commercial scale.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Hence, we will now introduce a new test-bedding component to APF to co-fund up to $500,000 for food farms that want to testbed new solutions.

sections.label: Incentives for graduate training
sections.summary: Participating farms can receive up to $15,000 in incentives per graduate to defray training costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Under this programme, participating farms can enjoy up to $15,000 worth of incentives for each graduate to defray their training costs.

sections.label: Farmers' Markets and local produce marketing
sections.summary: Farmers' Markets will be brought to heartlands by August this year, and AVA will partner SAFEF on a marketing plan for local produce.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: For that, I want to thank everyone for your support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We will keep up the momentum and bring Farmers' Markets to our heartlands by August this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: AVA will also partner SAFEF in developing a broader marketing plan for our local produce to raise our consumers' awareness.

sections.label: Divorce time bar and rental housing
sections.summary: The divorce time bar will be lifted, and HDB may offer rental housing to those in need and displaced by divorce.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Minister Lawrence Wong earlier announced that we will lift the divorce time bar.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: HDB may also offer rental housing to those in need and displaced by divorce.

sections.label: Families above income ceiling in rental
sections.summary: In the last three years, more than 470 families with income above the income ceiling were let into public rental.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: In the last three years, we let more than 470 families with income above the income ceiling enter public rental.

sections.label: Short-lease flat prices and grants
sections.summary: Short-lease flat price components are adjusted downwards by lease; first-timer seniors can pay as little as $3,000 and second-timers as little as $58,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: All price components for short-lease flats are adjusted downwards based on the lease chosen.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Now, with grants, first-timer seniors can buy a short-lease 2-room flexi flat for as little as $3,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: For second-timer seniors, we cap their resale levy at $30,000 and adjust it downwards based on the shorter lease.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: They can buy a 2-room flexi flat, on a 40-year lease, for as little as $58,000, including resale levy.

sections.label: Fresh Start Housing Scheme update
sections.summary: More than 130 second-timer rental families with young children applied to the Fresh Start Housing Scheme, and 61 have been emplaced.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Members will know of the Fresh Start Housing Scheme, for second-timer rental families with young children.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: I am pleased to update that more than 130 of such families applied, and 61 have been emplaced.

sections.label: Fresh Start minimum stay reduced
sections.summary: The minimum stay requirement for Fresh Start will be reduced from two years to one year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: With the Fresh Start grant of $20,000 and his CPF savings, Mr Chng bought the flat without a loan.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: For rental families who are ready to buy a flat, we want to help them do so sooner.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Therefore, we will reduce the minimum stay requirement for Fresh Start, from two years currently, to one year.

sections.label: Rental flats integrated into precincts
sections.summary: Rental flats are integrated into overall housing precincts with other flat types, so they are not isolated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, in response to the first question, rental flats are actually integrated into the overall housing precincts with other flat types, so they are not isolated.

sections.label: Privacy in Joint Singles Scheme
sections.summary: Since 2012, the new building plan has put facilities like partitioning in rental flats for Joint Singles Scheme co-staying privacy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For the second question about creating more privacy to help those in the Joint Singles Scheme, co-staying within a 1-room flat, since 2012, our new building plan already put in some facilities, like partitioning, in the rental flats.

sections.label: GRA work quality checks
sections.summary: Issues about the quality of work by the consultant or contractor under GRA can be raised and HDB will check.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: If there are issues concerning the quality of the work done by the consultant or the contractor brought in under GRA, you can certainly raise it and HDB will check.

sections.label: EUP rollout continues
sections.summary: EUP will continue to be rolled out as previously announced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, just to reply to Er Dr Lee Bee Wah's question, we will continue to roll out EUP as we had previously announced.

sections.label: Prequalification and local contractors
sections.summary: The selection will be done by year end, balancing prequalification requirements for complex projects with giving local contractors opportunities to build track records.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The selection, we have committed to doing it this year, and we will do it by the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The first is with regard to infrastructural projects where there are prequalification requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We have to strike a balance between ensuring that projects are carried out by builders who have capability and experience in doing so and, on the other hand, ensuring that the local contractors are given the opportunity to build track records.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, these are tensions we have to deal with every time when we call a tender, including a prequalification tender.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Certainly, we make sure that the requirements and the prequalification stage do not unfairly prejudice local firms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Because if you have never done a project before, you will never have the track record to other projects of a similar kind.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This is limited, therefore, to complex projects, involving a lot of technical expertise, such as, as I have said earlier, MRT and the deep tunneling works.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Having said that, even for MRT works, if you look at how LTA has done it, they parceled the projects in order to give local contractors an opportunity to learn how to do this.

sections.label: Agriculture Productivity Fund disbursement query
sections.summary: A Member asks Senior Minister of State Koh Poh Koon to clarify how much the Agriculture Productivity Fund has been disbursed to date.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I would like to thank Senior Minister of State Koh Poh Koon.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: I may have missed this, but could he clarify how much the Agriculture Productivity Fund (APF) has been disbursed to date?

sections.label: APF enhancement and plankton monitoring
sections.summary: The APF enhancement from $700,000 to $2 million is hoped to spur technology investment, while AVA monitors water quality and alerts farmers by SMS to plankton blooms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Hopefully, the enhancement to the APF that we announced earlier, from $700,000 to $2 million, will allow them to more seriously invest in useful technologies spread over a 20-year timeframe, and take on really productive technologies to move the sector forward.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: What AVA has done is that they have stepped up water quality monitoring, checking on the plankton count and also on the oxygenation level.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And when any of these parameters exceed a certain comfort level, AVA will send out SMSes to all the farmers on their mobile phones so that the farm operators or the owners will be alerted to a potential plankton bloom and take necessary precautions and remedial actions.

sections.label: Tender criteria for farm proposals
sections.summary: Farm or industry players with good productivity, technology adoption and local track record stand a better chance of winning the tender, which is based on fixed land price.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: What this means is that any farm or any industry player who wants to put up a good proposal with productivity enhancement, with good technology adoption and, more importantly, also with a good track record of having been successful locally, producing in good quantity of local produce that is accepted by our market, will stand a better chance of winning this tender.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, it is based on a fixed price, the price of the fair value of land rather than a bidding war.

sections.label: Studying options for outstanding blocks
sections.summary: A few options tried for outstanding blocks have not been effective, so options and newer technologies will continue to be studied for the difficult designs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For the outstanding ones, we have tried out a few options, they have not been effective.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, we will continue to study these options, whether there are newer technologies that will help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: There are not that many blocks left and these are more difficult designs which are very hard for us to put in the list in a cost-effective manner.

sections.label: PPHS rental while awaiting flats
sections.summary: PPHS provides interim rental while waiting for new flats, and last year's reduced rental rates make it more affordable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: That provides them with rental in the interim while they wait for their new flats to be ready.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: And as the Member would recall, we reduced PPHS rental rates last year, and that would make it even more affordable.

sections.label: Hiring engineers for track record
sections.summary: A local company without project experience can hire an engineer who has worked on such projects, and tenders are evaluated on firm experience and curricula vitae.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: So, if a local company itself has not undertaken such a project, it can hire a professional engineer or chief engineer who has worked on such projects before to boost the track record.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Certainly, in evaluating the tenders that are put in, we look not only at the firm's experience but, quite frequently, also look at the curricula vitae that are put in, and who will be working on those projects.
